description: Worksman SIDE-BY-SIDE "Team Dual" Trike SBST-3CB-HB Two Riders. Two Gear Sets. One Great Ride! The Worksman Team Dual Side By Side Trike lets two people ride together comfortably while each rider pedals at their own pace. With three speeds for each rider, each person can choose the gear that works best for them. This unique trike is ideal for companions, couples, families, special-needs applications, retirees, and resort or rental fleets. It is fun, functional, comfortable, and built to last. Standard Features Include: Three speeds for each rider Dual foot-operated coaster brakes Front hand-activated drum brake Thickly padded High Back Captain's Seats Rugged Worksman construction 600-pound maximum recommended weight capacity Electric Drive Upgrade Available – See Options Menu Below Shown above in Electric Blue with optional Swivel-Down Armrests. ★ CUSTOMIZE YOUR TEAM DUAL TRIKE ★ Your Team Dual can be customized to fit your needs. SCROLL DOWN to select your color, accessories, armrests, tires, electric drive upgrade, braking options, special-needs options, and other available upgrades. ↓↓ SCROLL DOWN TO BUILD YOUR CUSTOM TRIKE ↓↓ Be sure to review all of the available options before adding your trike to the cart. Need Help Choosing Your Options? Feel free to call us weekdays from 9:00 AM–5:00 PM at 800-962-2453, or email us at [email protected]. We're happy to assist you in selecting the upgrades and options that best fit your needs. Click Here for Side By Side Team Dual Frequently Asked Questions Special Needs? Consider the N21 Freewheel Option For situations where the right-side rider may have difficulty controlling the pedals, the optional N21 Freewheel can be especially helpful. With the N21 option, the passenger's pedals can rotate backward without activating the coaster brake. This can help prevent a rider from accidentally or unintentionally applying the brake by backpedaling. The Captain maintains control of the braking functions while the passenger can pedal when able, rest when necessary, and position the pedals comfortably without accidentally applying the coaster brake. The system can be converted back to the standard configuration in the future because the necessary components remain in place. See Option N21 in the options list to select this configuration. Ships 99% Fully Assembled via Truck The Team Dual ships 99% assembled. The handlebar, stem, and seats require adjustment and tightening, and the reflectors and basket must be attached. Dual Trike Factoids: Overall Width: 44.5" Maximum Recommended Weight Capacity: 600 lbs. Seat Height from Ground: 26.75" Seat Width: 18.5" Seat Back Height: 13.5" Thickly Padded High Back Seats Worksman Cycles — Proudly Made in America Since 1898* *Using high-quality domestic and imported components.
